story: The Long Tailed Nightjar (Caprimulgus climacurus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Caprimulgidae family. It is most commonly observed in Savanna; open habitats; arid semi-deserts; shrubland; and dry woodland, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Long Tailed Nightjar is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Long Tailed Nightjar into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
